description: Single, wages and interest: standard deduction, one exemption, state brackets plus 3.2% county tax
working: Form 502: FAGI = 86,000. Federal standard deduction taken, so Maryland standard deduction 3,400 (2026). Exemption: FAGI <= 100,000, so 3,200. Taxable net income = 86,000 - 3,400 - 3,200 = 79,400. State tax: 2% x 1,000 = 20; 3% x 1,000 = 30; 4% x 1,000 = 40; 4.75% x (79,400 - 3,000 = 76,400) = 3,629; total 3,719. Local tax (line 28): 79,400 x 3.2% = 2,540.80. Total = 6,259.80.
